description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useExplainGenerator' that simulates progressive explanation generation with staged content at different levels (ELI5, ELI15, Intermediate, Expert). It manages asynchronous staged updates with delays, supports cancellation, reset, and error handling, and is intended for use in React components to generate explanations dynamically.

methods.name: useExplainGenerator()
methods.description: Custom React hook that provides a staged explanation generator with control functions and state indicators.
